title: Small Business Saturday 2026
summary: Small businesses begin with a group of people who share hope and a vision for the future. You deserve insurance that understands what that’s like.
body_markdown:
### In 2010,[Small Business Saturday](https://www.sba.gov/about-sba/organization/observances/small-business-saturday/) was founded by American Express and officially co-sponsored by the U.S. Small Business Administration in 2011. Since then, it has played an important role in celebrating small businesses and acknowledging their contributions. ### Most small businesses begin with a group of people who share hope and a vision for the future. At[Donegal Insurance Group](https://www.donegalgroup.com/home) , we understand what that’s like;[our story](https://www.donegalgroup.com/about-us/our-history) began in a small town with a group of farmers. ### Our History We can relate to small businesses because we started as one. Back in 1889, in the town of Marietta in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, a small group of farmers came together to provide mutual protection for their farms and property. As with any small business, there were risks, including the limited product line and services only reaching a small area in central Pennsylvania. The first policy covered a local farmer’s home for $4,300, at an annual premium of $3.90. With such a low annual premium, farmers worked on razor-thin margins. Risk even translated into workflows, like manual bookkeeping and cramped office space. Nonetheless, we persevered, as many small businesses do, evolving into a trusted insurance provider with comprehensive personal and commercial property and casualty products. Now with more than 800 employees and over 138 years of insurance business experience, we serve four regions across the U.S., including Northeast, Greater Midwest, Southeast, and Southwest states. ### **Small Business & Insurance** Not only are small businesses the backbone of the U.S. economy, accounting for[44%](https://advocacy.sba.gov/2018/12/19/advocacy-releases-small-business-gdp-1998-2014/) of economic activity, but they’re also the heart of it. Running a small business means pouring your heart, time, and resources into making your dream a reality. That can be difficult, and the risks along the way can make it even harder. That’s where the right insurance can help, acting as a safety net to protect what you’ve worked so hard to build. At Donegal, we believe small businesses should be protected by insurance that understands what it takes to run a small business, create opportunity, and strengthen communities. With our Businessowners Insurance Program ([BOP](https://www.donegalgroup.com/our-products/commercial-insurance/businessowners-insurance) ), we are equipped to meet your unique business insurance needs and provide the protection you want, including your building, its contents, and liability coverage specific to your business. **ABOUT Donegal®** Donegal Insurance Group® provides property and casualty insurance products through a network of independent agents in 21 states across several regions of the U.S. The group includes Donegal Mutual Insurance Company and the insurance subsidiaries of Donegal Group Inc. (NASDAQ: DGICA and DGICB). In several Southwestern states, business is conducted as the Mountain States Insurance Group; and in Michigan, business is conducted as Michigan Insurance.
